description: This file defines the event handling interface for Redis's hiredis asynchronous adapter, including event loop integration and callback functions.

classes.name: redisAeEvents
classes.description: Structure holding context, event loop, file descriptor, and read/write state for Redis asynchronous event handling.

methods.name: redisAeReadEvent
methods.description: Handles read events by invoking redisAsyncHandleRead.

methods.name: redisAeWriteEvent
methods.description: Handles write events by invoking redisAsyncHandleWrite.

methods.name: redisAeAddRead
methods.description: Registers the file descriptor for read events.

methods.name: redisAeDelRead
methods.description: Unregisters the file descriptor from read events.

methods.name: redisAeAddWrite
methods.description: Registers the file descriptor for write events.

methods.name: redisAeDelWrite
methods.description: Unregisters the file descriptor from write events.

methods.name: redisAeCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up event resources and frees memory.

methods.name: redisAeAttach
methods.description: Attaches a redisAsyncContext to an event loop, setting up necessary callbacks.
